question: What is established by self-luminous awareness in this teaching?
premises: The teaching has shown its point to this extent.
Nothing can be established apart from that awareness.
inference: Therefore, self-luminous own-awareness establishes everything, and apart from it nothing at all is possible.
plain_english: Thus it has been shown to this extent: by self-luminous own-awareness everything is established, and apart from that nothing at all is possible.
